# Executive Summary

The following summary highlights key patterns identified in the elicitation results.

```{r, results='asis'}
cat(generate_executive_summary(report_data))
```

# Key Findings

# Facilitator Warnings

The following observations may warrant additional discussion or review.

```{r, results='asis'}
warnings <- generate_warnings(report_data)
if(length(warnings) == 1 &&
  warnings == "No notable facilitator warnings were identified.") {
  cat(warnings)
} else {
  for(w in warnings){
    cat(paste0("- ⚠ ", w, "\n"))
  }
}
```

# Participation Summary

```{r}
knitr::kable(
  report_data$participation
)
```

# Question Summary

The table below summarizes all elicitation questions.

```{r}
report_data$summary %>%
  select(Question, Round, EqW_Mean, ACW_Mean, Mean_AC, N_Participants) %>%
  kbl(digits = 3) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
                full_width = FALSE, position = "left")
```

# Revision Following Discussion

```{r}
if(!is.null(report_data$revision)){
  report_data$revision %>%
    select(Question, `1`, `2`, Revision) %>%
    kbl(digits = 3) %>%
    kable_styling(
      bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
      full_width = FALSE, position = "left")
} else {
  knitr::asis_output("This diagnostic is only available when multiple elicitation rounds are analyzed.")
}

```

# Largest Revision Following Discussion

```{r}
if(!is.null(report_data$revision)){
  build_revision_plot(report_data)
} else {
  knitr::asis_output(
    "Revision visualizations are only available for multi-round elicitation exercises.")
}
```

# Stability Following Discussion

The table below identifies questions exhibiting the smallest changes in pooled mean estimates between rounds.

```{r}
if(!is.null(report_data$stability)){
  report_data$stability %>%
    select(Question, `1`, `2`, Revision) %>%
    kbl(digits = 3) %>%
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped","hover","condensed"),
                  full_width = FALSE, position = "left")
} else {
  knitr::asis_output("This diagnostic is only available when multiple elicitation rounds are analyzed.")
}
```

# Assessment Confidence Weighting Effects

```{r}
acw_tbl <- report_data$summary %>%
  select(Question,Round, EqW_Mean, ACW_Mean, ACW_Effect ) %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(ACW_Effect)))
acw_tbl %>%
  kbl(digits = 3) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
                full_width = FALSE, position = "left")
```

# Assessment Confidence Summary

The table below summarizes participant assessment confidence for each question.

```{r}
report_data$summary %>%
  select(Question, Round, Mean_AC, Min_AC, Max_AC) %>%
  kbl(digits = 3) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped","hover","condensed"),
                full_width = FALSE, position = "left")
```

# Assessment Confidence Change

The table below summarizes changes in mean assessment confidence between rounds.

```{r}
if(!is.null(report_data$ac_change)){
  report_data$ac_change %>%
    select(Question, `1`, `2`, AC_Change) %>%
    kbl(digits = 3) %>%
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped","hover","condensed"),
                  full_width = FALSE, position = "left")
} else {

# Divergent Judgement

The table below ranks questions according to the spread of the Equal-Weight pooled distribution.

```{r}
report_data$spread %>%
  select(Question, Round, EqW_5th, EqW_95th, Spread) %>%
  kbl(digits = 3) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped","hover","condensed"),
                full_width = FALSE, position = "left")
```

# Greatest Spread in Expert Judgement

```{r}
top_div <- report_data$spread %>%
  slice(1)
build_spread_plot(report_data)

```

# Incomplete Participation

Differences in participation between rounds may influence the interpretation
of revision following discussion and assessment confidence metrics.
The table below summarizes participant retention for each question.

```{r}
if(!is.null(report_data$participation_change)){
  report_data$participation_change %>%
    select(Question, `1`, `2`,Participation_Retention) %>%
    kbl(digits = 3) %>%
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover","condensed"),
                  full_width = FALSE, position = "left")
  } else {
    knitr::asis_output("This diagnostic is only available when multiple elicitation rounds are analyzed.")
}
